How to activate Echofy in Android Auto
1. Open Android Auto app on your phone
2. Scroll to the bottom and tap on the version number
3. Tap repeatedly on \"Version information and permissions\" until you see \"You are now in developer mode\"
4. Tap the 3 dots at the top and go to \"Developer settings\", then enable \"Unknown sources\"
5. Restart Android Auto and Echofy will appear in the media apps list
